resolvedFindings.label: Early ICE candidate drop
resolvedFindings.resolution: RTCPeerConnection is now created eagerly in startCall and incoming ICE candidates arriving before remote description are buffered and drained after setRemoteDescription.

resolvedFindings.label: Dead idempotency guard allows PC overwrite
resolvedFindings.resolution: startCall initializes activeCall with a live RTCPeerConnection and call:accept checks call.pc.localDescription and isStartingOfferRef to prevent duplicate offer creations.

resolvedFindings.label: Unread badge accumulates on open conversation
resolvedFindings.resolution: The active conversation explicitly evaluates unread as 0 while open, and switching conversations accurately updates lastSeen to the last read message timestamp.

resolvedFindings.label: Typing flood on every keystroke
resolvedFindings.resolution: sendTyping is throttled to at most once every 500ms using sendTypingTimerRef.

resolvedFindings.label: Build not verified
resolvedFindings.resolution: Full TypeScript check (tsc -b) and Vite production build pass cleanly with exit code 0; build.txt verified.
